content.short: Pixieland is a TON Web3 game where players breed Pixie NFTs, trade them, own land, and join challenges.
content.description: Pixieland is a decentralized game on TON powered by NFTs and smart contracts. Its project page describes breeding, buying, selling, and trading Pixie NFTs, owning land NFTs, participating in challenges, staking tokens, and joining DAO governance. The game combines collectible ownership with an in-game economy rather than acting as a simple tap-to-earn app. Pixieland connects to TON through Telegram distribution, on-chain assets, token rewards, wallet-connected play, or community mechanics.
